description: This file provides Latvian ('lv') localization strings for the Select2 library version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines translations for various UI messages used within Select2 components, such as input length warnings, loading messages, and no-result notifications.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that the user input exceeds the maximum length, with correct pluralization.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message prompting the user to input more characters, with proper pluralization.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating data is being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message about the maximum number of selectable items, with pluralization.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no matching results found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a search is in progress.
